# awscc_mgn_network_migration_definition (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::MGN::NetworkMigrationDefinition



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network migration definition.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the network migration definition was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the network migration definition.
- `name` (String) The name of the network migration definition.
- `network_migration_definition_id` (String) The unique identifier of the network migration definition.
- `scope_tags` (Map of String) Scope tags for the network migration definition.
- `source_configurations` (Attributes List) A list of source configurations for the network migration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_configurations))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to assign to the network migration definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `target_deployment` (String) The target deployment configuration for the migrated network.
- `target_network` (Attributes) The target network configuration including topology and CIDR ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_network))
- `target_s3_configuration` (Attributes) The S3 configuration for storing the target network artifacts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_s3_configuration))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the network migration definition was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--source_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_configurations`

Read-Only:

- `source_environment` (String) The source environment type.
- `source_s3_configuration` (Attributes) S3 configuration for source network data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_configurations--source_s3_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--source_configurations--source_s3_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_configurations.source_s3_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `s3_bucket` (String) The name of the S3 bucket containing source data.
- `s3_bucket_owner` (String) The AWS account ID of the S3 bucket owner.
- `s3_key` (String) The S3 key (path) for the source data.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--target_network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_network`

Read-Only:

- `inbound_cidr` (String) The CIDR block for inbound traffic in the target network.
- `inspection_cidr` (String) The CIDR block for inspection traffic in the target network.
- `outbound_cidr` (String) The CIDR block for outbound traffic in the target network.
- `topology` (String) The network topology type for the target environment.
